customer.business: Almissa Digital: done-for-you AI guest assistant for holiday rentals, Omiš/Croatia
customer.target: Owners of 1 to 6 holiday apartments, rooms or villas on the Omiš to Makarska coast who host foreign guests (German, Polish, Czech, Italian, English) and are not technical
customer.where: Omiš, Split and the Makarska Riviera, Croatia

segments.name: Single-apartment family host (one unit in or next to the family house)
Small portfolio host (2 to 6 units, renting is a main income)
Villa owner with pool (high-end, weekly bookings, often lives abroad or in Split)

behaviours.name: Does everything by phone
behaviours.how: Answers every guest WhatsApp and Booking message personally, often at night; sees it as part of hospitality.

behaviours.name: Platform-reliant
behaviours.how: Uses Booking.com and Airbnb scheduled messages and a printed house-rules sheet; thinks that already covers it.

behaviours.name: Cost-cutter
behaviours.how: Avoids any monthly fee; asks a relative or neighbour for tech help.

behaviours.name: Review-obsessed
behaviours.how: Checks the Booking score weekly; a 9.2 vs 9.5 matters for price and ranking.

behaviours.name: Overwhelmed in peak season
behaviours.how: Has a day job or several units; July and August turnovers leave no time to reply.

behaviours.name: Uses a PMS or agency
behaviours.how: Already pays a channel manager (Smoobu, Rentlio) or a local agency that handles guest communication.

behaviours.name: Early adopter
behaviours.how: Already tried ChatGPT for translating messages; open to new tools if someone sets them up.

objections: My guests like talking to me personally, not to a robot
Booking and Airbnb already send automatic messages for free
What if the AI tells a guest the wrong thing and I get a bad review?
Another monthly subscription for only a few months of bookings
I don't trust a new one-person company with my guests
My guests ask the same three questions, I can answer them myself
Is this legal with guests' data (GDPR)?
habits: you clean and turn over the apartment yourself on Saturdays in summer
your adult son or daughter helps with the Booking.com extranet
you have a day job in Split and host on the side
you get 10 to 30 guest messages a day in August, many in German
you print a laminated sheet with the Wi-Fi password and house rules
you are registered on eVisitor and pay the tourist tax yourself

pitch:
"Mirni Kolovoz" (Quiet August) Season Pass from Almissa Digital, Omiš: an AI guest assistant for your holiday apartment.
Guests scan a QR card in the apartment, or open a link you add to your Booking/Airbnb welcome message, and get routine answers at any hour in their own language: Wi-Fi, check-in and check-out, parking, house rules, nearby beaches and restaurants. Every answer has a one-tap button to message you; anything it isn't sure of goes straight to your WhatsApp, so the personal conversations stay with you.
We set it up face to face in Omiš, Split or Makarska; you approve every answer before guests see it, and you send changes by WhatsApp.
Price: €120 per property for the whole season (May to October), each extra property +€60. Nothing charged November to April. No setup fee if you join by 31 March (after that €75 per property). WhatsApp and AI costs included.
Included: a signed GDPR data agreement (data stays in the EU), an end-of-August report of how many questions it answered, and a named backup contact.
Guarantee: if in the first 30 days it gives a wrong answer we don't fix within 24 hours, or you don't feel it saved you time, you get the season pass refunded in full.
Answer the price questions in euros per month for one property (€120 per season = €20 per month).
